settings.content: Asks for the visitor’s age on the first visit. This is a prompt, not a technical lock – check the rules for your industry.

settings.label: Heading
settings.info: [age] is replaced by the minimum age. Text in double square brackets is highlighted, e.g. [[refill]].
settings.default: Are you at least [age] years old?

settings.label: Text
settings.info: Text in double square brackets is highlighted, e.g. [[refill]].
settings.default: Some products in this store are intended for adults only.

settings.label: Link when declined

settings.content: Fragt beim ersten Besuch das Alter ab. Das ist eine Abfrage, keine technische Sperre – prüfen Sie die Regeln Ihrer Branche.

settings.label: Überschrift
